questions.q: How many crystal systems are there?
A stone of the cubic system is…
questions.why: It is the simplest optical family.

questions.q: How is the hexagonal system described?
choices: Three equal axes at 120° in one plane, and a perpendicular vertical axis
Two equal axes and a third oblique one
questions.why: It is the system of emerald and aquamarine.

questions.q: Quartz, ruby and tourmaline belong to the…
questions.why: It is close to hexagonal, with a three-fold axis.
Two optic axes and three indices.

questions.q: The habit of a crystal is…
choices: its outer shape, linked to the speed of growth along each axis
questions.why: Fast along c: a needle; fast along a and b: a plate.

questions.q: A crystal that grows very fast along the c axis takes the shape of…
questions.why: Fast along a and b: a plate.
One optic axis and two indices.

questions.q: Why is the stone turned under the instruments?
choices: Because the index, colour or hardness change with the direction
questions.why: This is also why the lapidary orients it to get the finest colour.

questions.q: What is said of the monoclinic system?
choices: Three unequal axes, one of them tilted: only one angle differs from 90°
questions.why: You find jadeite, spodumene (kunzite) and malachite in it.
